note: Statewide registered-voter totals for states without party registration (official sources; see scripts/registered_totals_update.py). Used as the turnout denominator on the national page.

in.basis: registered voters as of that election

hi.basis: registered voters as of that election

il.basis: registered voters ('Total Voters') as of that election

mn.note: TOTAL row of the 'Voter Counts by County as of October 1, 2026' table (county rows sum to it). The page blocks scripts; its county workbook (May 1, 2026) is parsed automatically as a fallback.

nd.as_of: SoS estimate used for the 2024 general election
nd.basis: eligible voters (SoS estimate from U.S. Census data; North Dakota has no voter registration)

oh.basis: registered voters as of the 2026 primary
oh.note: Secretary of State press release 'Secretary LaRose Certifies 2026 Official Primary Election Results': Total Registered Voters 7,896,681. ohiosos.gov and data.ohiosos.gov block scripts.

ms.note: Sum of the 82 counties' 'Number of Active Voters' in the SoS 'September 2026 Voter Count' report (pulled the first Monday of the month). sos.ms.gov blocks scripts, files included.
